verses.am: አብራምም የሦራን ቃል ሰማ። አብራምም በከነዓን ምድር አሥር ዓመት ከተቀመጠ በኋላ፥ የአብራም ሚስት ሦራ ግብፃዊት ባሪያዋን አጋርን ወስዳ ለባልዋ ለአብራም ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ ሰጠችው።

verses.en: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.am: እርሱም ወደ አጋር ገባ፥ አረገዘችም፤ እንዳረገዘችም ባየች ጊዜ እመቤትዋን በዓይንዋ አቃለለች።

verses.en: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: YAHUAH judge between me and thee.
verses.am: ሦራም አብራምን። መገፋቴ በአንተ ላይ ይሁን፤ እኔ ባሪያዬን በብብትህ ሰጠሁህ፤ እንዳረገዘችም ባየች ጊዜ እኔን በዓይንዋ አቃለለችኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ይፍረድ አለችው።

verses.en: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
verses.am: አብራምም ሦራን። እነሆ ባሪያሽ በእጅሽ ናት፤ እንደ ወደድሽ አድርጊባት አላት። ሦራም ባሠቀየቻት ጊዜ አጋር ከፊትዋ ኮበለለች።

verses.en: And the angel of YAHUAH found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም በውኃ ምንጭ አጠገብ በበረሀ አገኛት፤ ምንጩም ወደ ሱር በምትወስደው መንገድ አጠገብ ነው።

verses.en: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
verses.am: እርሱም። የሦራ ባሪያ አጋር ሆይ፥ ከወዴት መጣሽ? ወዴትስ ትሄጃለሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። እኔ ከእመቤቴ ከሦራ የኮበለልሁ ነኝ አለች።

verses.en: And the angel of YAHUAH said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም። ወደ እመቤትሽ ተመለሺ፥ ከእጅዋም በታች ሆነሽ ተገዥ አላት።

verses.en: And the angel of YAHUAH said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም። ዘርሽን እጅግ አበዛለሁ፥ ከብዛቱም የተነሣ አይቆጠርም አላት።

verses.en: And the angel of YAHUAH said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because YAHUAH hath heard thy affliction.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም አላት። እነሆ አንቺ ፀንሰሻል፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ትወልጃለሽ፤ ስሙንም እስማኤል ብለሽ ትጠሪዋለሽ፥ እግዚአብሔር መቸገርሽን ሰምቶአልና።

verses.en: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.am: እርሱም የበዳ አህያን የሚመስል ሰው ይሆናል፤ እጁ በሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል፥ የሁሉም እጅ ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ይሆናል፤ እርሱም በወንድሞቹ ሁሉ ፊት ይኖራል።

verses.en: And she called the name of YAHUAH that spake unto her, Thou YAHUAH seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
verses.am: እርስዋም ይናገራት የነበረውን የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ኤልሮኢ ብላ ጠራች፤ የሚያየኝን በውኑ እዚህ ደግሞ አየሁትን? ብላለችና።

verses.en: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የዚያ ጕድጓድ ስም ብኤርለሃይሮኢ ተብሎ ተጠራ፤ እርሱም በቃዴስና በባሬድ መካከል ነው።

verses.en: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
verses.am: አጋርም ለአብራም ወንድ ልጅን ወለደችለት፤ አብራምም አጋር የወለደችለትን የልጁን ስም እስማኤል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
verses.am: አጋር እስማኤልን ለአብራም በወለደችለት ጊዜ አብራም የሰማንያ ስድስት ዓመት ሰው ነበረ። a

verses.en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, YAHUAH appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty YAHUAH; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
verses.am: አብራምም የዘጠና ዘጠኝ ዓመት ሰው በሆነ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ለአብራም ተገለጠለትና። እኔ ኤልሻዳይ ነኝ፤ በፊቴ ተመላለስ፥ ፍጹምም ሁን፤

verses.en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔንም በእኔና በአንተ መካከል አደርጋለሁ፥ እጅግም አበዛሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Abram fell on his face: and YAHUAH talked with him, saying,
verses.am: አብራምም በግምባሩ ወደቀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው። እነሆ፥ ቃል ኪዳኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነው፤

verses.en: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
verses.am: ለብዙ አሕዛብም አባት ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
verses.am: ከዛሬም ጀምሮ እንግዲህ ስምህ አብራም ተብሎ አይጠራ፥ ነገር ግን ስምህ አብርሃም ይሆናል፤ ለብዙ አሕዛብ አባት አድርጌሃለሁና።

verses.en: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
verses.am: እጅግም አበዛሃለሁ፥ ሕዝብም አደርግሃለሁ፥ ነገሥታትም ከአንተ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a YAHUAH unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔንም በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ከአንተም በኋላ ከዘርህ ጋር በትውልዳቸው ለዘላለም ኪዳን አቆማለሁ፥ ለአንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘርህ አምላክ እሆን ዘንድ።

verses.en: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእንግድነት የምትኖርባትን ምድር፥ የከነዓን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ለዘላለም ግዛት ይሆንህ ዘንድ ለአንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘርህ እሰጣለሁ፤ አምላክም እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው። አንተ ደግሞ ቃል ኪዳኔን ትጠብቃለህ፥ አንተ ከአንተም በኋላ ዘርህ በትውልዳቸው።

verses.en: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
verses.am: በእኔና በአንተ መካከል፥ ከአንተም በኋላ በዘርህ መካከል የምትጠብቁት ቃል ኪዳኔ ይህ ነው፤ ከእናንተ ወንድ ሁሉ ይገረዝ።

verses.en: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
verses.am: የቍልፈታችሁንም ሥጋ ትገረዛላችሁ፤ በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል ላለውም ቃል ኪዳን ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
verses.am: የስምንት ቀን ልጅ ይገረዝ፤ በቤት የተወለደ ወይም ከዘራችሁ ያይደለ በብርም ከእንግዳ ሰው የተገዛ፥ ወንድ ሁሉ በትውልዳችሁ ይገረዝ።

verses.en: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.am: በቤትህ የተወለደ በብርህም የተገዛ ፈጽሞ ይገረዝ። ቃል ኪዳኔም በሥጋችሁ የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
verses.am: የቍልፈቱን ሥጋ ያልተገረዘ ቈላፍ ሰው ሁሉ፥ ያች ነፍስ ከወገንዋ ተለይታ ትጥፋ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔን አፍርሳለችና።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው። የሚስትህን የሦራን ስም ሦራ ብለህ አትጥራ፥ ስምዋ ሣራ ይሆናል እንጂ።

verses.en: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
verses.am: እባርካታለሁ፥ ደግሞም ከእርስዋ ልጅ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ እባርካትማለሁ፥ የአሕዛብም እናት ትሆናለች፤ የአሕዛብ ነገሥታት ከእርስዋ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
verses.am: አብርሃምም በግምባሩ ወደቀ፥ ሳቀም፥ በልቡም አለ። የመቶ ዓመት ሰው በውኑ ልጅ ይወልዳልን? ዘጠና ዓመት የሆናትም ሣራ ትወልዳለችን?

verses.en: And Abraham said unto YAHUAH, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
verses.am: አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔርን። እስማኤል በፊትህ ቢኖር በወደድሁ ነበር አለው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Yitschaq: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። በእውነት ሚስትህ ሣራ ወንድ ልጅን ትወልድልሃለች፥ ስሙንም ይስሐቅ ብለህ ትጠራዋለህ፤ ከእርሱ በኋላ ለዘሩ የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን እንዲሆን ቃል ኪዳኔን ከእርሱ ጋር አቆማለሁ።

verses.en: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.am: ስለ እስማኤልም ሰምቼሃለሁ፤ እነሆ ባርኬዋለሁ፥ ፍሬያምም አደርገዋለሁ፥ እጅግም አበዛዋለሁ፤ አሥራ ሁለት አለቆችንም ይወልዳል፥ ታላቅ ሕዝብም እንዲሆን አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: But my covenant will I establish with Yitschaq, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔን ግን በሚመጣው ዓመት በዚሁ ጊዜ ሣራ ከምትወልድልህ ከይስሐቅ ጋር አቆማለሁ።

verses.en: And he left off talking with him, and YAHUAH went up from Abraham.
verses.am: ንግግሩንም ከእርሱ ጋር በፈጸመ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከአብርሃም ተለይቶ ወጣ።

verses.en: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as YAHUAH had said unto him.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ልጁን እስማኤልን፥ በቤቱም የተወለዱትን ሁሉ፥ በብሩም የገዛቸውን ሁሉ፥ ከአብርሃም ቤተ ሰብ ወንዶቹን ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ የቍልፈታቸውንም ሥጋ እግዚአብሔር እንዳለው በዚያው ቀን ገረዘ።

verses.en: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የቍልፈቱን ሥጋ በተገረዘ ጊዜ የዘጠና ዘጠኝ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.am: ልጁ እስማኤልም የቍልፈቱን ሥጋ በተገረዘ ጊዜ የአሥራ ሦስት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ።

verses.en: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
verses.am: በዚያው ቀን አብርሃም ተገረዘ፥ ልጁ እስማኤልም።

verses.en: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
verses.am: በቤት የተወለዱትና በብር ከእንግዶች የተገዙት የቤቱ ሰዎች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገረዙ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
verses.am: በቀትርም ጊዜ እርሱ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ተቀምጦ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር በመምሬ የአድባር ዛፍ ተገለጠለት።

verses.en: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
verses.am: ዓይኑንም አነሣና እነሆ፥ ሦስት ሰዎች በፊቱ ቆመው አየ፤ ባያቸውም ጊዜ ሊቀበላቸው ከድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ተነሥቶ ሮጠ፥ ወደ ምድርም ሰገደ፥ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: And said, My Master, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በፊትህስ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ ባሪያህን አትለፈኝ ብዬ እለምናለሁ፤

verses.en: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
verses.am: ጥቂት ውኃ ይምጣላችሁ፥ እግራችሁን ታጠቡ፥ ከዚህችም ዛፍ በታች ዕረፉ፤

verses.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
verses.am: ቍራሽ እንጀራም ላምጣላችሁ፥ ልባችሁንም ደግፋ ከዚያም በኋላ ትሄዳላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ ወደ ባሪያችሁ መጥታችኋልና። እነርሱም። እንዳልህ አድርግ አሉት።

verses.en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ወደ ድንኳን ወደ ሣራ ዘንድ ፈጥኖ ገባና። ሦስት መስፈሪያ የተሰለቀ ዱቄት ፈጥነሽ አዘጋጂ፥ ለውሺውም፥ እንጎቻም አድርጊ አላት።

verses.en: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ወደ ላሞቹ ሮጠ፥ እጅግ የሰባም ታናሽ ጥጃ ያዘና ለብላቴናው ሰጠው፥ ያዘጋጅም ዘንድ ተቻኰለ።

verses.en: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
verses.am: እርጎና ወተትም ያዘጋጀውንም ጥጃ አመጣ፥ በፊታቸውም አቀረበው፤ እርሱም ከዛፉ በታች በፊታቸው ቆሞ ነበር፥ እነርሱም በሉ።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሚስትህ ሣራ ወዴት ናት? አሉት። እርሱም። በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ናት አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.am: እርሱም። የዛሬ ዓመት እንደ ዛሬው ጊዜ ወደ አንተ በእውነት እመለሳለሁ፤ ሚስትህ ሣራም ልጅን ታገኛለች አለ። ሣራም በድንኳን ደጃፍ በስተ ኋላው ሳለች ይህንን ሰማች።

verses.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
verses.am: አብርሃምና ሣራም በዕድሜአቸው ሸምግለው ፈጽመው አርጅተው ነበር፤ በሴቶች የሚሆነውም ልማድ ከሣራ ተቋርጦ ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
verses.am: ሣራም በልብዋ እንዲህ ስትል ሳቀች። ካረጀሁ በኋላ በውኑ ፍትወት ይሆንልኛልን? ጌታዬም ፈጽሞ ሸምግሎአል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው። ካረጀሁ በኋላ በውኑ እወልዳለሁን? ስትል ሣራ ለምን ሳቀች?

verses.en: Is any thing too hard for YAHUAH? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.am: በውኑ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሳነው ነገር አለን? የዛሬ ዓመት እንደ ዛሬው ጊዜ ወደ አንተ እመለሳለሁ፤ ሣራም ልጅን ታገኛለች።

verses.en: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
verses.am: ሣራም ስለ ፈራች። አልሳቅሁም ስትል ካደች። እርሱም። አይደለም፥ ሳቅሽ እንጂ አላት።

verses.en: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ከዚያ ተነሥተው ወደ ሰዶም አቀኑ፤ አብርሃምም ሊሸኛቸው አብሮአቸው ሄደ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እኔ የማደርገውን ከአብርሃም እሰውራለሁን?

verses.en: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.am: አብርሃም በእውነት ታላቅና ብርቱ ሕዝብ ይሆናልና፥ የምድር አሕዛብም ሁሉ በእርሱ ይባረካሉና።

verses.en: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of YAHUAH, to do justice and judgment; that YAHUAH may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
verses.am: ጽድቅንና ፍርድን በማድረግ የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ልጆቹንና ከእርሱ በኋላ ቤቱን እንዲያዝዝ አውቃለሁና፤ ይህም እግዚአብሔር በአብርሃም ላይ የተናገረውን ነገር ሁሉ ያመጣ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። የሰዶምና የገሞራ ጩኸት እጅግ በዝቶአልና፥ ኃጢአታቸውም እጅግ ከብዳለችና፥

verses.en: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
verses.am: እንግዲህስ ወደ እኔ እንደ መጣች እንደ ጩኸትዋ አድርገው እንደ ሆነ ወርጄ አያለሁ፤ እንዲሁም ባይሆን አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ከዚያ ፊታቸውን አቀኑ፥ ወደ ሰዶምም ሄዱ፤ አብርሃም ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ገና ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.am: አብርሃምም ቀረበ አለም። በውኑ ጻድቁን ከኃጢአተኛ ጋር ታጠፋለህን?

verses.en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
verses.am: አምሳ ጻድቃን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ ቢገኙ በውኑ ሁሉን ታጠፋለህን? ከተማይቱንስ በእርስዋ ስለሚገኙ አምሳ ጻድቃን አትምርምን?

verses.en: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
verses.am: ይህ ከአንተ ይራቅ፤ ጻድቁን ከኃጢአተኛ ጋር ትገድል ዘንድ፥ ጻድቁም እንደ ኃጢአተኛ ይሆን ዘንድ፥ እንደዚህ ያለው አድራጎት ከአንተ ይራቅ። የምድር ሁሉ ፈራጅ በቅን ፍርድ አይፈርድምን?

verses.en: And YAHUAH said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። በሰዶም በከተማይቱ ውስጥ አምሳ ጻድቃን ባገኝ ስፍራውን ሁሉ ስለ እነርሱ እምራለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto YAHUAH, which am but dust and ashes:
verses.am: አብርሃምም መለሰ አለም። እኔ አፈርና አመድ ስሆን ከጌታዬ ጋር እናገር ዘንድ እነሆ አንድ ጊዜ ጀመርሁ፤

verses.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
verses.am: ከአምሳው ጻድቃን አምስት ቢጐድሉ ከተማይቱን ሁሉ በአምስቱ ምክንያት ታጠፋለህን? ከዚያ አርባ አምስት ባገኝ አላጠፋትም አለ።

verses.en: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.
verses.am: ደግሞም ተናገረው፥ እንዲህም አለ። ምናልባት ከዚያ አርባ ቢገኙሳ? እርሱም። ለአርባው ስል አላደርገውም አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Oh let not YAHUAH be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታዬ አይቆጣ እኔም እናገራለሁ ምናልባት ከዚያ ሠላሳ ቢገኙሳ? አለ። እርሱም ከዚያ ሰላሳ ባገኝ አላጠፋም አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto YAHUAH: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.
verses.am: ደግሞም። እነሆ፥ ከጌታዬ ጋር እናገር ዘንድ አንድ ጊዜ ጀመርሁ፤ ምናልባት ከዚያ ሀያ ቢገኙሳ? አለ። እርሱም። ከዚያ ሀያ ቢገኙ ስለ ሀያው አላደርገውም አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Oh let not YAHUAH be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.
verses.am: እርሱም። እኔ ደግሞ አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ብናገር ጌታዬ አይቆጣ፤ ምናልባት ከዚያ አሥር ቢገኙሳ? አለ። እርሱም። ስለ አሥሩ አላጠፋትም አለ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከአብርሃም ጋር ንግግሩን በጨረሰ ጊዜ ሄደ፤ አብርሃምም ወደ ስፍራው ተመለሰ። a

verses.en: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
verses.am: ሁለቱም መላእክት በመሸ ጊዜ ወደ ሰዶም ገቡ፤ ሎጥም በሰዶም በር ተቀምጦ ነበር። ሎጥም ባያቸው ጊዜ ሊቀበላቸው ተነሣ፤ ፊቱንም ደፍቶ ወደ ምድር ሰገደ፥ አላቸውም።

verses.en: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
verses.am: ጌቶቼ ሆይ፥ ወደ ባሪያችሁ ቤት አቅኑ፥ ከዚያም እደሩ፥ እግራችሁንም ታጠቡ፤ ነገ ማልዳችሁም መንገዳችሁን ትሄዳላችሁ። እነርሱም። በአደባባዩ እናድራለን እንጂ፥ አይሆንም አሉት።

verses.en: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
verses.am: እጅግም ዘበዘባቸው፤ ወደ እርሱም አቀኑ፥ ወደ ቤቱም ገቡ፤ ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ ቂጣንም ጋገረ እነርሱም በሉ።

verses.en: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
verses.am: ገናም ሳይተኙ የዚያች ከተማ የሰዶም ሰዎች፥ ከብላቴናው ጀምሮ እስከ ሽማግሌው ድረስ በየስፍራው ያለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ቤቱን ከበቡት።

verses.en: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
verses.am: ሎጥንም ጠርተው እንዲህ አሉት። በዚህ ሌሊት ወደ ቤትህ የገቡት ሰዎች ወዴት ናቸው? እናውቃቸው ዘንድ ወደ እኛ አውጣቸው።

verses.en: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
verses.am: ሎጥም ወደ እነርሱ ወደ ደጅ ወጣ መዝጊያውንም በኋላው ዘጋው፤

verses.en: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ይህን ክፉ ነገር አታድርጉ፤

verses.en: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ወንድን ያላወቁ ሁለት ሴቶች ልጆች አሉኝ፤ እነርሱን ላውጣላችሁ፥ እንደ ወደዳችሁም አድርጓቸው፤ በእነዚህ ሰዎች ብቻ ምንም አታድርጉ፥ እነርሱ በጣራዬ ጥላ ሥር ገብተዋልና።

verses.en: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ወዲያ ሂድ አሉት። ደግሞም እንዲህ አሉ። ይህ ሰው በእንግድነት ለመኖር መጣ፥ ፍርዱንም ይፈርድ ዘንድ ይፈልጋል፤ አሁን በአንተ ከእነርሱ ይልቅ ክፉ እናደርግብሃለን። ሎጥንም እጅግ ተጋፉት፥ የደጁንም መዝጊያ ለመስበር ቀረቡ።

verses.en: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
verses.am: ሁለቱም ሰዎች እጃቸውን ዘርግተው ሎጥን ወደ እነርሱ ዘንድ ወደ ቤት አገቡት መዝጊያውንም ዘጉት።

verses.en: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.am: በቤቱ ደጃፍ የነበሩትንም ሰዎች ከታናሻቸው ጀምሮ እስከ ታለቃቸው ድረስ አሳወሩአቸው፤ ደጃፉንም ለማግኘት ሲፈልጉ ደከሙ።

verses.en: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
verses.am: ሁለቱም ሰዎች ሎጥን አሉት። ከዚህ ሌላ ማን አለህ? አማችም ቢሆን ወንድ ልጅም ቢሆን ወይም ሴት ልጅ ብትሆን በከተማይቱ ያለህን ሁሉ ከዚህ ስፍራ አስወጣቸው፤

verses.en: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of YAHUAH; and YAHUAH hath sent us to destroy it.
verses.am: እኛ ይህን ስፍራ እናጠፋለንና፥ ጩኸታቸው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትልቅ ሆኖአልና፤ እናጠፋውም ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሰድዶናል።

verses.en: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for YAHUAH will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
verses.am: ሎጥም ወጣ፥ ልጆቹን ለሚያገቡት ለአማቾቹም ነገራቸው፥ አላቸውም። ተነሡ፤ ከዚህ ስፍራ ውጡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ይህችን ከተማ ያጠፋልና። ለአማቾቹ ግን የሚያፌዝባቸው መሰላቸው።

verses.en: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
verses.am: ጎህም በቀደደ ጊዜ መላእክት ሎጥን። ተነሣ፥ ሚስትህንና ከዚህ ያሉትን ሁለቱን ሴቶች ልጆችህን ውሰድ፤ በከተማይቱ ኃጢአት እንዳትጠፋ እያሉ ያስቸኵሉት ነበር።

verses.en: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; YAHUAH being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
verses.am: እርሱም በዘገየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ስላዘነለት እነዚያ ሰዎች የእርሱን እጅ የሚስቱንም እጅ የሁለቱን የሴቶች ልጆቹንም እጅ ይዘው አወጡትና በከተማይቱ ውጭ አስቀመጡት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
verses.am: ወደ ሜዳም ካወጡአቸው በኋላ እንዲህ አለው። ራስህን አድን፤ ወደ ኋላህ አትይ፥ በዚህም ዙሪያ ሁሉ አትቁም እንዳትጠፋም ወደ ተራራው ሸሽተህ አምልጥ።

verses.en: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Master:
verses.am: ሎጥም፤ አላቸው። ጌቶቼ ሆይ፥ እንዲህስ አይሁን፤

verses.en: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
verses.am: እነሆ ባሪያህ በፊትህ ሞገስን አግኝቶአል፥ ነፍሴን ለማዳን ያደረግህልኝን ምሕረትህንም አብዝተሃል፤ ክፉ እንዳያገኘኝና እንዳልሞት ወደ ተራራ ሸሽቼ አመልጥ ዘንድ አልችልም፤

verses.en: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
verses.am: እነሆ ይህች ከተማ ወደ እርስዋ ሸሽቶ ለማምለጥ ቅርብ ናት፥ እርስዋም ትንሽ ናት፤ ነፍሴን ለማዳን ወደ እርስዋ ሸሽቼ ላምልጥ፤ እርስዋ ትንሽ ከተማ አይደለችምን?

verses.en: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። የተናገርሃትን ከተማ እንዳላጠፋት እነሆ በዚህ ነገር የለመንኸኝን ተቀብዬሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.am: በቶሎ ወደዚያ ሸሽትህ አምልጥ፤ ወደዚያ እስክትደርስ ድረስ ምንም አደርግ ዘንድ አልችልምና። ስለዚህም የዚያች ከተማ ስም ዞዓር ተባለ።

verses.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
verses.am: ሎጥ ወደ ዞዓር በገባ ጊዜ ፀሐይ በምድር ላይ ወጣች።

verses.en: Then YAHUAH rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from YAHUAH out of heaven;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሰዶምና በገሞራ ላይ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ከሰማይ እሳትና ዲን አዘነበ፤

verses.en: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
verses.am: እነዚያንም ከተሞች፥ በዙሪያቸው ያለውንም ሁሉ፥ በከተሞቹም የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ፥ የምድሩንም ቡቃያ ሁሉ ገለበጠ።

verses.en: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.am: የሎጥም ሚስት ወደ ኋላዋ ተመለከተች፥ የጨው ሐውልትም ሆነች።

verses.en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before YAHUAH:
verses.am: አብርሃምም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆሞ ወደ ነበረበት ስፍራ ለመሄድ ማልዶ ተነሣ፤

verses.en: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.am: ወደ ሰዶምና ወደ ገሞራ በዚያች አገር ወዳለውም ምድር ሁሉ ተመለከተ፤ እነሆም የአገሪቱ ጢስ እንደ እቶን ጢስ ሲነሣ አየ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when YAHUAH destroyed the cities of the plain, that YAHUAH remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እነዚያን የአገር ከተሞች ባጠፋ ጊዜ አብርሃምን አሰበው፤ ሎጥ ተቀምጦበት የነበረውንም ከተማ ባጠፋ ጊዜ ከዚያ ጥፋት መካከል ሎጥን አወጣው።

verses.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.am: ሎጥም ከዞዓር ወጣ፤ በዞዓር ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ስለ ፈራም ከሁለቱ ሴቶች ልጆቹ ጋር በተራራ ተቀመጠ፤ በዋሻም ከሁለቱ ሴቶች ልጆቹ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
verses.am: ታላቂቱም ታናሺቱን አለቻት። አባታችን ሸመገለ፥ በምድርም ሁሉ እንዳለው ልማድ ሊገናኘን የሚችል ሰው ከምድር ላይ የለም፤

verses.en: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.am: ነዪ አባታቻንንም የወይን ጠጅ እናጠጣውና ከእርሱ ጋር እንተኛ፥ ከአባታችንም ዘር እናስቀር።

verses.en: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.am: በዚያችም ሌሊት አባታቸውን የወይን ጠጅ አጠጡት፤ ታላቂቱም ገባች፥ ከአባትዋም ጋር ተኛች፤ እርሱም ስትተኛና ስትነሣ አላወቀም።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.am: በነጋውም ታላቂቱ ታናሺቱን አለቻት። እነሆ ትናንት ከአባቴ ጋር ተኛሁ፤ ዛሬ ሌሊት ደግሞ የወይን ጠጅ እናጠጣው አንቺም ግቢና ከእርሱ ጋር ተኚ፥ ከአባታችንም ዘር እናስቀር።

verses.en: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.am: አባታቸውንም በዚያች ሌሊት ደግሞ የወይን ጠጅ አጠጡት፤ ታናሺቱም ገብታ ከእርሱ ጋር ተኛች፤ እርሱም ስትተኛና ስትነሣ አላወቀም።

verses.en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
verses.am: የሎጥም ሁለቱ ሴቶች ልጆች ከአባታቸው ፀነሱ።

verses.en: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
verses.am: ታላቂቱም ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች ስሙንም ሞዓብ ብላ ጠራችው፤ እርሱም እስከ ዛሬ የሞዓባውያን አባት ነው።

verses.en: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
verses.am: ታናሺቱም ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች ስሙንም። የወገኔ ልጅ ስትል አሞን ብላ ጠራችው፤ እርሱም እስከ ዛሬ የአሞናውያን አባት ነው።

verses.en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ከዚያ ተነሥቶ ወደ አዜብ ምድር ሄደ፥ በቃዴስና በሱር መካከልም ተቀመጠ፤ በጌራራም በእንግድነት ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሚስቱን ሣራን። እኅቴ ናት አለ፤ የጌራራ ንጉሥ አቢሜሌክም ላከና ሣራን ወሰዳት።

verses.en: But YAHUAH came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሌሊት በሕልም ወደ አቢሜሌክ መጣ፥ እንዲህም አለው። እነሆ፥ አንተ ስለ ወሰድሃት ሴት ምውት ነህ፤ እርስዋ ባለ ባል ናትና።

verses.en: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, YAHUAH, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
verses.am: አቢሜሌክ ግን አልቀረባትም ነበር፤ እንዲህም አለ። አቤቱ፥ ጻድቁን ሕዝብ ደግሞ ታጠፋለህን?

verses.en: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
verses.am: እኅቴ ናት ያለኝ እርሱ አይደለምን? እርስዋም ደግሞ ራስዋ። ወንድሜ ነው አለች፤ በልቤ ቅንነትና በእጄ ንጹሕነት ይህንን አደረግሁ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሕልም አለው። ይህን በልብህ ቅንነት እንዳደረግህ እኔ አወቅሁ፥ እኔም ደግሞ በፊቴ ኃጢአትን እንዳትሠራ ከለከልሁህ፤ ስለዚህም ትነካት ዘንድ አልተውሁም።

verses.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
verses.am: አሁንም የሰውዬውን ሚስት መልስ፤ ነቢይ ነውና፥ ስለ አንተም ይጸልያል፥ ትድናለህም። ባትመልሳት ግን አንተ እንድትሞት ለአንተ የሆነውም ሁሉ እንዲሞት በእርግጥ እወቅ።

verses.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም በነገታው ማለደ፥ ባሪያዎቹንም ሁሉ ጠራ፥ ይህንንም ነገር ሁሉ በጆሮአቸው ተናገረ፤ ሰዎቹም እጅግ ፈሩ።

verses.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አብርሃምን ጠርቶ አለው። ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው? ምንስ ክፉ ሠራሁብህ? በእኔና በመንግሥቴ ላይ ትልቅ ኃጢአት አውርደሃልና፤ የማይገባ ሥራ በእኔ ሠራህብኝ።

verses.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አብርሃምን አለው። ይህን ማድረግህ ምን አይተህ ነው?

verses.en: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of YAHUAH is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
verses.am: አብርሃምም አለ። በዚህ ስፍራ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በእውነት እንደሌለ፥ ለሚስቴም ሲሉ እንደሚገድሉኝ ስላሰብሁ ነው።

verses.en: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.am: እርስዋም ደግሞ በእውነት እኅቴ ናት፤ የእናቴ ልጅ አይደለችም እንጂ የአባቴ ልጅ ናት፤ ለእኔም ሚስት ሆነች።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when YAHUAH caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከአባቴ ቤት ባወጣኝ ጊዜ አልኋት። በገባንበት አገር ሁሉ ለእኔ የምታደርጊው ወሮታ ይህ ነው። ወንድሜ ነው ብለሽ ስለ እኔ ተናገሪ።

verses.en: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም በጎችንና ላሞችን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችን አመጣ፥ ለአብርሃምም ሰጠው፥ ሚስቱን ሣራንም መለሰለት።

verses.en: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም። እነሆ፥ ምድሬ በፊትህ ናት፤ በወደድኸው ተቀመጥ አለ።

verses.en: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
verses.am: ሣራንም አላት። እነሆ፥ ለወንድምሽ ሺህ ሚዛን ብር ሰጠሁት፤ ያም እነሆ ከአንቺ ጋር ባሉት ሁሉ ፊት የዓይኖች መሸፈኛ ይሁንሽ፤ ጽድቅሽ ለሰዎች ሁሉ ተገልጦአልና።

verses.en: So Abraham prayed unto YAHUAH: and YAHUAH healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አቢሜሌክን ሚስቱንም ባሪያዎቹንም ፈወሳቸው፥ እነርሱም ወለዱ፤

verses.en: For YAHUAH had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአብርሃም ሚስት በሣራ ምክንያት በአቢሜሌክ ቤት ማኅፀኖችን ሁሉ በፍጹም ዘግቶ ነበርና። a

verses.en: And YAHUAH visited Sarah as he had said, and YAHUAH did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረው ሣራን አሰበ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረው ለሣራ አደረገላት።

verses.en: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which YAHUAH had spoken to him.
verses.am: ሣራም ፀነሰች፥ እግዚአብሔርም በተናገረው ወራት ለአብርሃም በእርጅናው ወንድ ልጅን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Yitschaq.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የተወለደለትን ሣራ የወለደችለትን የልጁን ስም ይስሐቅ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Abraham circumcised his son Yitschaq being eight days old, as YAHUAH had commanded him.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ልጁን ይስሐቅን እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው በስምንተኛ ቀን ገረዘው።

verses.en: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Yitschaq was born unto him.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ልጁ ይስሐቅ በተወለደለት ጊዜ የመቶ ዓመት ዕድሜ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Sarah said, YAHUAH hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
verses.am: ሣራም። እግዚአብሔር ሳቅ አድርጎልኛል፤ ይህንንም የሚሰማ ሁሉ በእኔ ምክንያት ይስቃል አለች።

verses.en: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ሣራ ልጆችን እንድታጠባ ለአብርሃም ማን በነገረው? በእርጅናው ልጅን ወልጄለታለሁና አለች።

verses.en: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Yitschaq was weaned.
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ ጡትንም ከመጥባት ተቋረጠ፤ አብርሃምም ይስሐቅን ጡት ባስጣለበት ቀን ትልቅ ግብዣን አደረገ።

verses.en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Mitsri, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
verses.am: ሣራም ግብፃዊቱ አጋር ለአብርሃም የወለደችለትን ልጅ ሲስቅ አየችው።

verses.en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Yitschaq.
verses.am: አብርሃምንም። ይህችን ባሪያ ከነልጅዋ አሳድድ፤ የዚህች ባሪያ ልጅ ከልጄ ከይስሐቅ ጋር አይወርስምና አለችው።

verses.en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
verses.am: ይህም ነገር በአብርሃም ዘንድ ስለ ልጁ እጅግ ችግር ሆነበት።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Yitschaq shall thy seed be called.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው። ስለ ባሪያህና ስለ ብላቴናው አትዘን፤ ሣራም የምትነግርህን ቃል ሁሉ ስማ፤ በይስሐቅ ዘር ይጠራልሃልና።

verses.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
verses.am: የባሪያይቱን ልጅ ደግሞ ሕዝብ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ዘርህ ነውና።

verses.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ እንጀራንም ወሰደ፥ የውኃ አቁማዳንም ለአጋር በትከሻዋ አሸከማት፥ ብላቴናውንም ሰጥቶ አስወጣት፤ እርስዋም ሄደች በቤርሳቤህም ምድረ በዳ ተቅበዘበዘች።

verses.en: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.am: ውኃውም ከአቁማዳው አለቀ፤ ብላቴናውንም ከአንድ ቍጥቋጦ በታች ጣለችው፤

verses.en: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
verses.am: እርስዋም ሄደች። ብላቴናው ሲሞት አልየው ብላ ቀስት ተወርውሮ የሚደርስበትን ያህል ርቃ በአንጻሩ ተቀመጠች። ፊት ለፊትም ተቀመጠች፥ ቃልዋንም አሰምታ አለቀሰች።

verses.en: And YAHUAH heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of YAHUAH called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for YAHUAH hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የብላቴናውን ድምፅ ሰማ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ከሰማይ አጋርን እንዲህ ሲል ጠራት። አጋር ሆይ፥ ምን ሆንሽ? እግዚአብሔር የብላቴናውን ድምፅ ባለበት ስፍራ ሰምቶአልና አትፍሪ።

verses.en: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
verses.am: ተነሺ፥ ብላቴናውንም አንሺ፥ እጅሽንም በእርሱ አጽኚው፤ ትልቅ ሕዝብ አደርገዋለሁና።

verses.en: And YAHUAH opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ዓይንዋን ከፈተላት፥ የውኃ ጕድጓድንም አየች፤ ሄዳም አቁማዳውን በውኃ ሞላች፥ ብላቴናውንም አጠጣች።

verses.en: And YAHUAH was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከብላቴናው ጋር ነበረ፤ አደገም፥ በምድረ በዳም ተቀመጠ፥ ቀስተኛም ሆነ።

verses.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: በፋራን ምድረ በዳም ተቀመጠ፤ እናቱም ከምድረ ግብፅ ሚስት ወሰደችለት።

verses.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, YAHUAH is with thee in all that thou doest:
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን አቢሜሌክ ከሙሽራው ወዳጅ ከአኮዘትና ከሠራዊቱ አለቃ ከፊኮል ጋር አብርሃምን አለው። በምታደርገው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነው፤

verses.en: Now therefore swear unto me here by YAHUAH that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
verses.am: አሁንም በእኔም በልጄም በልጅ ልጄም ክፉ እንዳታደርግብኝ በእግዚአብሔር ማልልኝ፤ ነገር ግን ለአንተ ቸርነትን እንዳደረግሁ አንተም ለእኔ ለተቀመጥህባትም ምድር ቸርነትን ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: And Abraham said, I will swear.
verses.am: አብርሃምም። እኔ እምላለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክንም ባሪያዎቹ በነጠቁት በውኃ ጕድጓድ ምክንያት አብርሃም ወቀሰው።

verses.en: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አለ። ይህን ነገር ያደረገውን አላወቅሁም፤ አንተም ደግሞ ምንም አልነገርኸኝም፥ እኔም ከዛሬ በቀር አልሰማሁም።

verses.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በጎችንና ላሞችን አምጥቶ ለአቢሜሌክ ሰጠው፤ ሁለቱም ቃል ኪዳን አደረጉ።

verses.en: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሰባት ቄቦች በጎችን ለብቻቸው አቆመ።

verses.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አብርሃምን። ለብቻቸው ያቆምሃቸው እነዚህ ሰባት ቄቦች በጎች ምንድር ናቸው? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
verses.am: እርሱም። እኔ ይህችን የውኃ ጕድጓድ እንደቆፈርሁ ምስክር ይሆንልኝ ዘንድ እነዚህን ሰባት ቄቦች በጎች ከእጄ ትወስዳለህ አለው።

verses.en: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ቤርሳቤህ ብሎ ጠራው፤ ከዚያ ሁለቱ ተማምለዋልና።

verses.en: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.am: በቤርሳቤህም ቃል ኪዳንን አደረጉ። አቢሜሌክና የሙሽራው ወዳጅ አኮዘት የሠራዊቱ አለቃ ፊኮልም ተነሥተው ወደ ፍልስጥኤም ምድር ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of YAHUAH, the everlasting YAHUAH.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በቤርሳቤህ የተምር ዛፍን ተከለ፤ በዚያም የዘላለሙን አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ጠራ።

verses.en: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በፍልስጥኤም ምድር ብዙ ቀን እንግዳ ሆኖ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that YAHUAH did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
verses.am: ከእነዚህም ነገሮች በኋላ እግዚአብሔር አብርሃምን ፈተነው፥ እንዲህም አለው። አብርሃም ሆይ። አብርሃምም። እነሆ፥ አለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Yitschaq, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
verses.am: የምትወደውን አንድ ልጅህን ይስሐቅን ይዘህ ወደ ሞሪያም ምድር ሂድ፤ እኔም በምነግርህ በአንድ ተራራ ላይ በዚያ መሥዋዕት አድርገህ ሠዋው አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Yitschaq his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which YAHUAH had told him.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በማለዳ ተነሥቶ አህያውን ጫነ፥ ሁለቱንም ሎሌዎቹንና ልጁን ይስሕቅን ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፥ እንጨትንም ለመሥዋዕት ሰነጠቀ፤ ተነሥቶም እግዚአብሔር ወዳለው ቦታ ሄደ።

verses.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን አብርሃም ዓይኑን አነሣና ቦታውን ከሩቅ አየ።

verses.en: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሎሌዎቹን አላቸው። አህያውን ይዛችሁ ከዚህ ቆዩ፤ እኔና ልጄ ወደዚያ ሄደን እንሰግዳለን፥ ወደ እናንተም እንመለሳለን።

verses.en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Yitschaq his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የመሥዋዕቱን እንጨት አንሥቶ ለልጁ ለይስሐቅ አሸከመው፤ እርሱም እሳቱንና ቢላዋውን በእጁ ያዘ፥ ሁለቱም አብረው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And Yitschaq spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
verses.am: ይስሐቅም አባቱን አብርሃምን ተናገረው። አባቴ ሆይ አለ። እርሱም። እነሆኝ፥ ልጄ አለው። እሳቱና እንጨቱ ይኸው አለ፤ የመሥዋዕቱ በግ ግን ወዴት ነው? አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham said, My son, YAHUAH will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
verses.am: አብርሃምም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ የመሥዋዕቱን በግ እግዚአብሔር ያዘጋጃል አለው፤ ሁለቱም አብረው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And they came to the place which YAHUAH had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Yitschaq his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ወዳለውም ቦታ ደረሱ፤ አብርሃምም በዚያ መሠዊያውን ሠራ፥ እንጨትንም ረበረበ፤ ልጁን ይስሐቅንም አስሮ በመሠዊያው በእንጨቱ ላይ አጋደመው።

verses.en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.am: አብርሃምም እጁን ዘረጋ፥ ልጁንም ያርድ ዘንድ ቢላዋ አነሣ።

verses.en: And the angel of YAHUAH called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም ከሰማይ ጠራና። አብርሃም አብርሃም አለው፤

verses.en: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest YAHUAH, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
verses.am: እርሱም። እነሆኝ አለ። እርሱም። በብላቴናው ላይ እጅህን አትዘርጋ፥ አንዳችም አታድርግበት፤ አንድ ልጅህን ለእኔ አልከለከልህምና እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈራ እንደ ሆንህ አሁን አውቄአለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ዓይኑን አነሣ፥ በኋላውም እነሆ አንድ በግ በዱር ውስጥ ቀንዶቹ በዕፀ ሳቤቅ ተይዞ አየ፤ አብርሃምም ሄደ በጉንም ወሰደው፥ በልጁም ፋንታ መሥዋዕት አድርጎ ሠዋው።

verses.en: And Abraham called the name of that place YAHUAH-Yireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of YAHUAH it shall be seen.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ያንን ቦታ ያህዌ ይርኤ ብሎ ጠራው፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ይታያል ይባላል።

verses.en: And the angel of YAHUAH called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም አብርሃምን ከሰማይ ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ጠራው፥

verses.en: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith YAHUAH, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
verses.am: እንዲህም አለው። እግዚአብሔር። በራሴ ማልሁ ይላል፤ ይህን ነገር አድርገሃልና፥ አንድ ልጅህንም አልከለከልህምና

verses.en: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
verses.am: በእውነት በረከትን እባርክሃለሁ፥ ዘርህንም እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብትና በባሕር ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ አበዛዋለሁ፤ ዘርህም የጠላቶችን ደጅ ይወርሳል፤

verses.en: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
verses.am: የምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉም በዘርህ ይባረካሉ፥ ቃሌን ሰምተሃልና።

verses.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ወደ ብላቴኖቹ ተመለሰ፥ ተነሥተውም ወደ ቤርሳቤህ አብረው ሄዱ፤ አብርሃምም በቤርሳቤህ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
verses.am: ይህም ከሆነ በኋልላ ለአብርሃም እንዲህ ተብሎ ተነገረ። እነሆ፥ ሚልካ ደግሞ ለወንድምህ ለናኮር ልጆችን ወለደች፤

verses.en: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.am: እነርሱም በኵሩ ዑፅ፥ ወንድሙ ቡዝ፥ የአራም አባት ቀሙኤል፥

verses.en: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
verses.am: ኮዛት፥ ሐዞ፥ ፊልዳሥ፥ የድላፍ፥ ባቱኤል ናቸው።

verses.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
verses.am: ባቱኤልም ርብቃን ወለደ፤ እነዚህን ስምንቱን ሚልካ ለአብርሃም ወንድም ለናኮር ወለደች።

verses.en: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
verses.am: ሬሕማ የሚሉአት ቁባቱ ደግሞ ጥባህን፥ ገአምን፥ ተሐሸን፥ ሞክሳን ወለደች። a

verses.en: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.am: የሣራም ዕድሜ መቶ ሀያ ሰባት ዓመት ሆነ።

verses.en: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.am: በቂርያትአርባቅም ሞተች፤ እርስዋም በከነዓን ምድር ያለች ኬብሮን ናት፤ አብርሃምም ለሣራ ሊያዝንላትና ሊያለቅስላት ተነሣ።

verses.en: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.am: አብርሃምም ከሬሳው አጠገብ ተነሣ፥

verses.en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
verses.am: ለኬጢ ልጆችም እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረ። እኔ በእናንተ ዘንድ ስደተኛና መጻተኛ ነኝ፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ የመቃብር ርስት ስጡኝ፥ ሬሳዬንም ከፊቴ ልቅበር።

verses.en: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.am: የኬጢ ልጆችም ለአብርሃም መለሱ፥ አሉትም።

verses.en: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ስማን፤ አንተ በእኛ መካከል ከእግዚአብሔር አለቃ ነህ፤ ከመቃብር ስፍራችን በመልካሙ ቦታ ሬሳህን ቅበር፤ ሬሳህን ትቀብር ዘንድ ከእኛ መቃብሩን የሚከለክልህ የለም።

verses.en: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ተነሣ፥ ለምድሩ ሕዝብም፥ ለኬጢ ልጆች፥ ሰገደ።

verses.en: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ሬሳዬን ከፊቴ እንድቀብር ከወደዳችሁስ ስሙኝ፥ ከሰዓር ልጅ ከኤፍሮንም ለምኑልኝ፤

verses.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
verses.am: በእርሻው ዳር ያለችውን ድርብ ክፍል ያላትን ዋሻውን በሙሉ ዋጋ በመካከላችሁ ይስጠኝ፥ መቃብሩ የእኔ ርስት እንዲሆን።

verses.en: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.am: ኤፍሮንም በኬጢ ልጆች መካከል ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ የኬጢ ሰው ኤፍሮንም የኬጢ ልጆችና ወደ ከተማ የሚገቡ ሁሉ ሲሰሙ ለአብርሃም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰለት።

verses.en: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
verses.am: አይደለም፥ ጌታዬ፥ ስማኝ፤ እርሻውን ሰጥቼሃለሁ በእርሱም ዳር ያለውን ዋሻ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በወገኔ ልጆች ፊት ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ ሬሳህን ቅበር።

verses.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
verses.am: አብርሃምም በአገሩ ሰዎች ፊት ሰገደ፤

verses.en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
verses.am: የአገሩ ሰዎችም ሲሰሙ ለኤፍሮን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረ። ነገሬን ትሰማ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ፤ የእርሻውን ዋጋ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ አንተም ከእኔ ዘንድ ውሰድ፥ ሬሳዬንም በዚያ እቀብራለሁ።

verses.en: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.am: ኤፍሮንም ለአብርሃም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰለት።

verses.en: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
verses.am: ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እኔን ስማኝ፤ የአራት መቶ ሰቅል ዋጋ ምድር በእኔና በአንተ መካክለ ምንድር ነው? ሬሳህንም ቅበር።

verses.en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የኤፍሮንን ነገር ሰማ፤ አብርሃምም በኬጢ ልጆች ፊት የነገረውን አራት መቶ ሰቅል መዝኖ ለኤፍሮን ሰጠው፤ ብሩም ለመሸጫ ለመለወጫ የሚተላለፍ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
verses.am: በመምሬ ፊት ያለው ባለድርብ ክፍል የሆነው የኤፍሮን እርሻ ለአብርሃም ጸና፤

verses.en: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
verses.am: እርሻው በእርሱም ያለው ዋሻው፥ በእርሻውም ውስጥ በዙሪያውም ያለው እንጨት ሁሉ በኬጢ ልጆችና በከተማይቱ በር በሚገቡ ሁሉ ፊት ለአብርሃም ርስቱ ሆነ።

verses.en: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኬብሮን በምትባል በመምሬ ፊት በከነዓን ምድር ባለው እርሻ ባለ ድርብ ክፍል በሆነው ዋሻ ውስጥ አብርሃም ሚስቱን ሣራን ቀበረ።

verses.en: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
verses.am: እርሻውና በእርሱ ያለው ዋሻው በኬጢ ልጆች ዘንድ ለአብርሃም የመቃብር ርስት ሆኖ ጸና።

verses.en: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and YAHUAH had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሸመገለ በዘመኑም አረጀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን በሥራው ሁሉ ባረከው።

verses.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
verses.am: አብርሃምም ሎሌውን የቤቱን ሽማግሌ የከብቱን ሁሉ አዛዥ አለው።

verses.en: And I will make thee swear by YAHUAH, YAHUAH of heaven, and YAHUAH of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
verses.am: እጅህን ከጭኔ በታች አድርግ፥ እኔም አብሬ ከምኖራቸው ከከነዓን ሴቶች ልጆች ለልጄ ሚስት እንዳትወስድለት በሰማይና በምድር አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር አምልሃለሁ፤

verses.en: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Yitschaq.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ አገሬና ወደ ተወላጆቼ ትሄዳለህ፥ ለልጄ ለይስሐቅም ሚስትን ትወስድለታለህ።

verses.en: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
verses.am: ሎሌውም። ሴቲቱ ምናልባት ወደዚህ አገር ከእኔ ጋር ለመምጣት እንቢ ያለች እንደ ሆነ ልጅህን ወደ ወጣህበት አገር ልመልሰውን? አለው።

verses.en: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
verses.am: አብርሃምም አለው። ልጄን ወደዚያ እንዳትመልስ ተጠንቀቅ፤

verses.en: YAHUAH of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
verses.am: ከአባቴ ቤት ከተወለድሁባት ምድርም ያወጣኝ። ይህችንም ምድር እሰጥሃለሁ ብሎ የነገረኝና የማለልኝ የሰማይ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱ መልአኩን በፊትህ ይሰድዳል፥ ከዚያም ለልጄ ሚስትን ትወስዳለህ።

verses.en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ከአንተ ጋር ለመምጣት እንቢ ያለች እንደ ሆነ ከዚህ ካቀረብሁህ መሐላ ንጹሕ ነህ፤ ልጄን ግን ወደዚያ አትመልሰው።

verses.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
verses.am: ሎሌውም ከጌታው ከአብርሃም ጭን በታች እጁን አደረገ ስለዚሁም ነገር ማለለት።

verses.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
verses.am: ሎሌውም ከጌታው ግመሎች መካከል አሥር ግመሎችን ወስዶ፥ ከጌታውም ዕቃ መልካም መልካሙን ይዞ ተነሣ፤ ተነሥቶም ወደ መስጼጦምያ ወደ ናኮር ከተማ ሄደ።

verses.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.am: ሲመሽም ሴቶች ውኃ ሊቀዱ በሚወጡበት ጊዜ ከከተማይቱ ውጪ በውኃው ጕድጓድ አጠገብ ግመሎቹን አስበረከከ።

verses.en: And he said, O YAHUAH of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። የጌታዬ የአብርሃም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እለምንሃለሁ፤ መንገዴን ዛሬ በፊቴ አቅናልኝ፥ ለጌታዬም ለአብርሃም ምሕረትን አድርግ።

verses.en: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዚህ የውኃ ምንጭ አጠገብ እኔ ቆሜአለሁ፥ የዚህችም ከተማ ሴቶች ልጆች ውኃውን ሊቀዱ ይመጣሉ፤

verses.en: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Yitschaq; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
verses.am: ውኃ እጠጣ ዘንድ እንስራሽን አዘንብዪ የምላት እርስዋም። አንተ ጠጣ፥ ግመሎችህን ደግሞ አጠጣለሁ የምትለኝ ቆንጆ፥ እርስዋ ለባሪያህ ለይስሐቅ ያዘጋጀሃት ትሁን፤ በዚህም ለጌታዬ ምሕረትን እንዳደረግህ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
verses.am: ይህን መናገሩንም ሳይፈጽም እነሆ፥ ሚልካ የወለደችው የባቱኤል ልጅ ርብቃ እንስራዋን በጫንቃዋ ተሸክማ ወጣች፤ ሚልካም የአብርሃም ወንድም የናኮር ሚስት ናት።

verses.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.am: ብላቴናይቱም መልክዋ እጅግ ያማረ፥ ወንድ የማያውቃት ድንግልም ነበረች፤ ወደ ምንጭም ወረደች እንስራዋንም ሞላች፥ ተመልሳም ወጣች።

verses.en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
verses.am: ሎሌውም ሊገናኛት ሮጠና። ከእንስራሽ ጥቂት ውኃ ታጠጪኝ ዘንድ እለምንሻለሁ አላት።

verses.en: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
verses.am: እርስዋም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ጠጣ አለችው፤ ፈጥናም እንስራዋን በእጅዋ አውርዳ አጠጣችው።

verses.en: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
verses.am: እርሱንም ካጠጣች በኋላ። ለግመሎችህ ደግሞ ሁሉም እስኪረኩ ድረስ ውኃ እቀዳለሁ አለች።

verses.en: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
verses.am: ፈጥናም ውኃውን ከእንስራዋ በማጠጫው ውስጥ ገለበጠችው፥ ደግሞም ልትቀዳ ወደ ጕድጓዱ ሮጠች፥ ለግመሎቹም ሁሉ ውኃ ቀዳች።

verses.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether YAHUAH had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.am: ሰውዮውም ትክ ብሎ ይመለከታት ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር መንገዱን አቅንቶለት እንደ ሆነ ወይም እንዳልሆነ ለማወቅም ዝም አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
verses.am: ግመሎቹም ከጠጡ በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሰውዮው ግማሽ ሰቅል የሚመዘን የወርቅ ቀለበት፥ ለእጆችዋም አሥር ሰቅል የሚመዘን ጥንድ የወርቅ አምባር አወጣ፤

verses.en: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
verses.am: እንዲህም አላት። አንቺ የማን ልጅ ነሽ? እስኪ ንገሪኝ፤ በአባትሽ ቤት የምናድርበት ስፍራ ይገኛልን?

verses.en: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
verses.am: አለችውም። እኔ ሚልካ ለናኮር የወለደችው የባቱኤል ልጅ ነኝ።

verses.en: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
verses.am: በእኛ ዘንድ ገለባና ገፈራ የሚበቃ ያህል አለ፥ ለማደሪያም ደግሞ ስፍራ አለን።

verses.en: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሰውዮውም አጎነበሰ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ሰገደ ።

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be YAHUAH of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, YAHUAH led me to the house of my master's brethren.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ቸርነቱንና እውነቱን ከጌታዬ ያላራቀ የጌታዬ የአብርሃም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን፤ እኔ በመንገድ ሳለሁ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ጌታዬ ወንድሞች ቤት መራኝ።

verses.en: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.
verses.am: ብላቴናይቱም ሮጠች፥ ለእናትዋም ቤት ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ተናገረች።

verses.en: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
verses.am: ለርብቃም ላባ የተባለ ወንድም ነበራት፤ ላባም ወደ ውጪ ወደ ውኃው ምንጭ ወደ ሰውዮው ሮጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
verses.am: ቀለበቱንና አምባሮቹን በእኅቱ እጅ ባየ ጊዜ፥ የእኅቱን የርብቃንም ነገር። ያ ሰው እንዲህ አለኝ ያለችውን በሰማ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ ወደዚያ ሰው መጣ፤ እነሆም፥ በውኃው ምንጭ አጠገብ ከግመሎቹ ዘንድ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of YAHUAH; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ቡሩክ፥ ግባ፤ ስለምን አንተ በውጪ ቆመሃል? እኔም ቤቱን ለግመሎችህም ስፍራ አዘጋጅቼአለሁ።

verses.en: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
verses.am: ሰውዮውም ወደ ቤት ገባ፥ ግመሎቹንም አራገፈ፤ ገለባና ገፈራም ለግመሎቹ አቀረበ፤ እግሩን ይታጠብ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ላሉት ሰዎች እግር ውኃ አቀረበ።

verses.en: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
verses.am: መብልንም በፊቱ አቀረበለት፤ እርሱ ግን። ነገሬን እስክናገር ድረስ አልበላም አለ። እርሱም። ተናገር አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። እኔ የአብርሃም ሎሌ ነኝ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጌታዬን እጅግ ባረከው፥ አገነነውም፤ በጎችንና ላሞችን፥ ብርንም፥ ወርቅንም፥ ወንዶች ባሪያዎችንና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችን፥ ግመሎችንም አህዮችንም ሰጠው።

verses.en: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
verses.am: ሣራም የጌታዬ ሚስት በእርጅናው ለጌታዬ ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች፤ የነበረውንም ሁሉ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
verses.am: ጌታዬም እንዲህ ሲል አማለኝ። እኔ ካለሁበት አገር ከከነዓናውያን ሴቶች ልጆች ለልጄ ሚስትን አትውሰድ

verses.en: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ አባቴ ቤት ወደ ወገኔም ሂድ፥ ለልጄም ሚስትን ውሰድለት።

verses.en: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
verses.am: ጌታዬንም። ሴቲቱ ምናልባት ባትከተለኝሳ? አልሁት።

verses.en: And he said unto me, YAHUAH, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
verses.am: እርሱም አለኝ። አካሄዴን በፊቱ ያደረግሁለት እግዚአብሔር መልአኩን ከአንተ ጋር ይልካል፥ መንገድህንም ያቀናል። ለልጄም ከወገኖቼ ከአባቴም ቤት ሚስትን ትወስዳለህ፤

verses.en: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ከመሐላዬ ንጹሕ ነህ፤ ወደ ዘመዶቼ ሄደህ እነርሱ ባይሰጡህ ካማልሁህ መሐላ ንጹሕ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O YAHUAH of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
verses.am: ዛሬም ወደ ውኃው ምንጭ መጣሁ፥ እንዲህም አልሁ። የጌታዬ የአብርሃም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ዛሬ የምሄድበትን መንገዴን ብታቀናልኝ፤

verses.en: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ በውኃው ምንጭ ላይ ቆሜአለሁ፤ ውኃ ልትቀዳ ለምትመጣውም ቆንጆ። ጥቂት ውኃ ከእንስራሽ አጠጪኝ ስላት፥

verses.en: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom YAHUAH hath appointed out for my master's son.
verses.am: እርስዋም። አንተ ጠጣ፥ ደግሞም ለግመሎችህ እቀዳለሁ የምትለኝ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለጌታዬ ልጅ ያዘጋጃት ሴት እርስዋ ትሁን።

verses.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
verses.am: እኔም የልቤን መናገር ገና ሳልፈጽም፥ እነሆ፥ ርብቃ እንስራዋን በትከሻዋ ተሸክማ ወጣች፥ ወደ ምንጭም ወርዳ ውኃ ቀዳች፤ እኔም። እስኪ አጠጪኝ አልኋት።

verses.en: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
verses.am: ፈጥናም እንስራዋን ከጫንቃዋ አወረደችና። አንተ ጠጣ፥ ግመሎችህንም ደግሞ አጠጣለሁ አለች፤ እኔም ጠጣሁ፥ ግመሎቼንም ደግሞ አጠጣች።

verses.en: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
verses.am: እኔም። አንቺ የማን ልጅ ነሽ? ብዬ ጠየቅኋት። እርስዋም። ሚልካ ለናኮር የወለደችለት የባቱኤል ልጅ ነኝ አለች፤ ቀለበትም አደረግሁላት፥ ለእጆችዋም አምባሮች አደረግሁላት።

verses.en: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped YAHUAH, and blessed YAHUAH of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.
verses.am: በግምባሬም አጎነበስሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ሰገድሁ፤ የጌታዬን የወንድሙን ልጅ ለልጁ እወስድ ዘንድ በቀና መንገድ የመራኝን የጌታዬን የአብርሃምን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገንሁ።

verses.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
verses.am: አሁንም ቸርነትና እውነት ለጌታዬ ትሠሩ እንደ ሆነ ንገሩኝ፤ ይህም ባይሆን ንገሩኝ፥ ወደ ቀኝ ወይም ወደ ግራ እል ዘንድ።

verses.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from YAHUAH: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
verses.am: ላባና ባቱኤልም መለሱ እንዲህም አሉ። ነገሩ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መጥቶአል ክፉም በጎም ልንመልስልህ አንችልም።

verses.en: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as YAHUAH hath spoken.
verses.am: ርብቃ እንኋት በፊትህ ናት፤ ይዘሃት ሂድ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ ለጌታህም ልጅ ሚስት ትሁን።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped YAHUAH, bowing himself to the earth.
verses.am: የአብርሃምም ሎሌ ነገራቸውን በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ምድር ወድቆ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰገደ።

verses.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
verses.am: ሎሌውም የብርና የወርቅ ጌጥ ልብስም አወጣ፥ ለርብቃም ሰጣት፤ የከበረ ስጦታንም ለወንድምዋና ለእናትዋ አቀረበ።

verses.en: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
verses.am: እርሱም ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉት በሉ ጠጡም፥ ከዚያም አደሩ፤ ማልደውም ተነሡና። ወደ ጌታዬ እሄድ ዘንድ አሰናብቱኝ አላቸው ።

verses.en: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
verses.am: ወንድምዋና እናትዋም። ብላቴናይቱ አንድ አሥር ቀን ያህል እንኳ ከእኛ ዘንድ ትቀመጥ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ትሄዳለች አሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing YAHUAH hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
verses.am: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር መንገዴን አቅንቶልኛልና አታዘግዩኝ፤ ወደ ጌታዬ እሄድ ዘንድ አሰናብቱኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ብላቴናይቱን እንጥራና ከአፍዋ እንጠይቅ አሉ።

verses.en: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
verses.am: ርብቃንም ጠርተው። ከዚህ ሰው ጋር ትሄጃለሽን? አሉአት። እርስዋም። እሄዳለሁ አለች።

verses.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
verses.am: እኅታቸውንም ርብቃን ሞግዚትዋንም የአብርሃምን ሎሌና ሰዎቹንም አሰናበቱአቸው።

verses.en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
verses.am: ርብቃንም መረቁአትና። አንቺ እኅታችን፥ እልፍ አእላፋት ሁኚ፤ ዘርሽም የጠላቶችን ደጅ ይውረስ አሉአት።

verses.en: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.am: ርብቃም ተነሣች ደንገጥሮችዋም፥ በግመሎችም ላይ ተቀምጠው ያንን ሰው ተከተሉት፤ ሎሌውም ርብቃን ተቀብሎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And Yitschaq came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ብኤርለሃይሮኢ በሚሉአት ምንጭ መንገድ መጣ፤ በአዜብ ምድር ተቀምጦ ነበርና።

verses.en: And Yitschaq went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም በመሸ ጊዜ በልቡ እያሰላሰለ ወደ ሜዳ ወጥቶ ነበር፤ ዓይኖቹንም አቀና፥ እነሆም ግመሎች ሲመጡ አየ።

verses.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Yitschaq, she lighted off the camel.
verses.am: ርብቃም ዓይኖችዋን አቀናች፥ ይስሐቅንም አየች፥ ከግመልም ወረደች።

verses.en: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
verses.am: ሎሌውንም። ሊገናኘን በሜዳ የሚመጣ ይህ ሰው ማን ነው? አለችው። ሎሌውም። እርሱ ጌታዬ ነው አላት፤ እርስዋም መሸፈኛ ወስዳ ተከናነበች።

verses.en: And the servant told Yitschaq all things that he had done.
verses.am: ሎሌውም ያደረገውን ነገር ሁሉ ለይስሐቅ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Yitschaq brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Yitschaq was comforted after his mother's death.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ወደ እናቱ ወደ ሣራ ድንኳን አገባት፥ ርብቃንም ወሰዳት፥ ሚስትም ሆነችው፥ ወደዳትም፤ ይስሐቅም ከእናቱ ሞት ተጽናና። a

verses.en: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ደግሞ ስምዋ ኬጡራ የተባላች ሚስት አገባ።

verses.en: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.am: እርስዋም ዘምራንን፥ ዮቅሳንን፥ ሜዳንን፥ ምድያምን፥ የስቦቅን፥ ስዌሕን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.am: ዮቅሳንም ሳባንና ድዳንን ወለደ። የድዳንም ልጆች አሦርያውያን፥ ለጡሳውያን፥ ለኡማውያን ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.am: የምድያምም ልጆች ጌፌር፥ ዔፌር፥ ሄኖኅ፥ አቢዳዕ፥ ኤልዳዓ ናቸው። እነዚህ ሁሉ የኬጡራ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Yitschaq.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የነበረውን ሁሉ ለይስሐቅ ሰጠው፤

verses.en: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Yitschaq his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
verses.am: የአብርሃምም ለነበሩ ለቁባቶቹ ልጆች አብርሃም ስጦታን ሰጣቸው፤ እርሱም ገና በሕይወቱ ሳለ ከልጁ ከይስሐቅ ለይቶ ወደ ፀሐይ መውጫ ወደ ምሥራቅ አገር ሰደዳቸው።

verses.en: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
verses.am: አብርሃምም የኖረበት የዕድሜው ዓመታት እነዚህ ናቸው፤ መቶ ሰባ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ነፍሱን ሰጠ፥ በመልካም ሽምግልናም ሞተ፤ ሸመገለም፥ ብዙ ዘመንም ጠገበ፤ ወደ ወገኖቹም ተከማቸ።

verses.en: And his sons Yitschaq and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
verses.am: ልጆቹ ይስሐቅና እስማኤልም በመምሬ ፊት ለፊት ባለው በኬጢያዊ በሰዓር ልጅ በኤፍሮን እርሻ ላይ ባለ ድርብ ክፍል በሆነው ዋሻ ውስጥ ቀበሩት ።

verses.en: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.am: አብርሃም ከኬጢ ልጆች የገዛው እርሻ ይህ ነው፤ አብርሃምና ሚስቱ ሣራ ከዚያ ተቀበሩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that YAHUAH blessed his son Yitschaq; and Yitschaq dwelt by the well Lahairoi.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ከሞተ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ልጁን ይስሐቅን ባረከው፤ ይስሐቅም ብኤርለሃይሮኢ ተብሎ በሚጠራው ምንጭ አጠገብ ኖረ።

verses.en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Mitsri, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
verses.am: የሣራ ባሪያ ግብፃዊቱ አጋር ለአብርሃም የወለደችው የአብርሃም ልጅ የእስማኤል ትውልድ ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.am: የእስማኤልም የልጆቹ ስም በየስማቸውና በየትውልዳቸው እንዲህ ነው፤ የእስማኤል የበኵር ልጁ

verses.en: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
verses.am: ነባዮት፥ ቄዳር፥ ነብዳኤል፥ መብሳም፥ ማስማዕ፥

verses.en: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
verses.am: ዱማ፥ ማሣ፥ ኩዳን፥ ቴማን፥ ኢጡር፥ ናፌስ፥ ቄድማ።

verses.en: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.am: የእስማኤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፥ ስማቸውም በየመንደራቸውና በየሰፈራቸው ይኸው ነው፤ በየወገናቸውም አሥራ ሁለት አለቆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
verses.am: እስማኤልም የኖረበት የዕድሜው ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ዓመት ነው፤ ነፍሱን ሰጠ ሞተም፤ ወደ ወገኖቹም ተከማቸ።

verses.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Mitsrayim, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.am: መኖሪያቸውም ከኤውላጥ አንሥቶ በግብፅ ፊት ለፊት እስከምትገኝ እስከ ሱር ድረስ ወደ አሦር በምትወስደው መንገድ ላይ ነበረ፤ እንዲህም በወንድሞቹ ሁሉ ፊት ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And these are the generations of Yitschaq, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Yitschaq:
verses.am: የአብርሃም ልጅ የይስሐቅ ትውልድም ይህ ነው፤ አብርሃም ይስሐቅን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Yitschaq was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም አርባ ዓመት ሲሆነው ርብቃን አገባ፤ እርስዋም በሁለት ወንዞች መካከል ያለ የሶርያዊው የባቱኤል ልጅና የሶርያዊው የላባ እኅት ናት።

verses.en: And Yitschaq intreated YAHUAH for his wife, because she was barren: and YAHUAH was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ስለሚስቱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፥ መካን ነበረችና፤ እግዚአብሔርም ተለመነው፥ ርብቃም ሚስቱ ፀነሰች።

verses.en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ልጆችም በሆድዋ ውስጥ ይገፋፉ ነበር፤ እርስዋም። እንዲህ ከሆነ ይህ ለእኔ ምኔ ነው? አለች። ከእግዚአብሔርም ትጠይቅ ዘንድ ሄደች።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አላት። ሁለት ወገኖች በማኅፀንሽ ናቸው፥ ሁለቱም ሕዝብ ከሆድሽ ይከፈላሉ፤ ሕዝብም ከሕዝብ ይበረታል፤ ታላቁም ለታናሹ ይገዛል።

verses.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.am: ትወልድ ዘንድ ዘመንዋ በተፈጸመ ጊዜም፥ እነሆ፥ በማኅፀንዋ መንታ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
verses.am: በፊትም የወጣው ቀይ ነበረ፥ ሁለንተናውም ጠጕር ለብሶ ነበር፤ ስሙም ዔሳው ተባለ።

verses.en: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Ya'aqob: and Yitschaq was threescore years old when she bare them.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ወንድሙ ወጣ፥ በእጁም የዔሳውን ተረከዝ ይዞ ነበር፤ ስሙም ያዕቆብ ተባለ። እርስዋ ልጆችን በወለደቻቸው ጊዜ ይስሐቅ ስድሳ ዓመት ሆኖት ነበር።

verses.en: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Ya'aqob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
verses.am: ብላቴኖቹም አደጉ፤ ዔሳውም አደን የሚያውቅ የበረሃ ሰው ሆነ፤ ያዕቆብ ግን ጭምት ሰው ነበረ፥ በድንኳንም ይቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And Yitschaq loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Ya'aqob.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ዔሳውን ይወድ ነበር፥ ካደነው ይበላ ነበርና፤ ርብቃ ግን ያዕቆብን ትወድ ነበረች።

verses.en: And Ya'aqob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ወጥ ሠራ፤ ዔሳውም ደክሞ ከበረሃ ገባ፤

verses.en: And Esau said to Ya'aqob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
verses.am: ዔሳውም ያዕቆብን። ከዚህ ከቀዩ ወጥ አብላኝ፥ እኔ እጅግ ደክሜአለሁና አለው፤ ስለዚህ ስሙ ኤዶም ተባለ።

verses.en: And Ya'aqob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም። በመጀመሪያ ብኵርናህን ሽጥልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
verses.am: ዔሳውም። እነሆ፥ እኔ ልሞት ነኝ፤ ይህች ብኵርና ለምኔ ናት? አለ ።

verses.en: And Ya'aqob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Ya'aqob.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም። እስኪ በመጀመሪያ ማልልኝ አለው። ማለለትም፤ ብኵርናውንም ለያዕቆብ ሸጠ።

verses.en: Then Ya'aqob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ለዔሳው እንጀራና የምስር ወጥ ሰጠው፤ በላ፥ ጠጣ፥ ተነሥቶም ሄደ፤ እንዲሁም ዔሳው ብኵርናውን አቃለላት።

verses.en: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Yitschaq went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
verses.am: በምድርም ቀድሞ በአብርሃም ዘመን ከሆነው ራብ በላይ ራብ ሆነ፤ ይስሐቅም ወደ ፍልስጥኤም ንጉሥ ወደ አቢሜሌክ ወደ ጌራራ ሄደ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Mitsrayim; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ተገለጠለት፥ እንዲህም አለው። ወደ ግብፅ አትውረድ፥ እኔ በምልህ ምድር ተቀመጥ እንጂ።

verses.en: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
verses.am: በዚህች ምድር ተቀመጥ፥ ከአንተ ጋርም እሆናለሁ፥ እባርክሃለሁም፤ እነዚህን ምድሮች ሁሉ ለአንተም ለዘርህም እሰጣለሁና፥ ለአባትህ ለአብርሃም የማልሁለትንም መሐላ አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
verses.am: ዘርህንም እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት አበዛለሁ፥ እነዚህንም ምድሮች ሁሉ ለዘርህ እሰጣለሁ፤ የምድርም አህዛብ ሁሉ በዘርህ ይባረካሉ፤

verses.en: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
verses.am: አብርሃም ቃሌን ሰምቶአልና፥ ፍርዴን ትእዛዜን ሥርዓቴን ሕጌንም ጠብቆአልና።

verses.en: And Yitschaq dwelt in Gerar:
verses.am: ይስሐቅም በጌራራ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
verses.am: የዚያም ስፍራ ሰዎች ስለ ሚስቱ ጠየቁት፤ እርሱም። እኅቴ ናት አለ፤ የዚህ ስፍራ ስዎች ለርብቃ ሲሉ እንዳይገድሉኝ ብሎ ሚስቴ ናት ማለትን ፈርቶአልና፤ እርስዋ ውብ ነበረችና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Yitschaq was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
verses.am: በዚያም ብዙ ቀን ከተቀመጠ በኋላ የፍልስጥኤም ንጉሥ አቢሜሌክ በመስኮት ሆኖ ጎበኘ፥ ይስሐቅም ሚስቱን ርብቃን ሲዳራት አየ።

verses.en: And Abimelech called Yitschaq, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Yitschaq said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም ይስሐቅን ጠራ፥ እንዲህም አለው። እነሆ ሚስትህ ናት፤ እንዴትስ እርስዋን። እኅቴ ናት አልህ? ይስሐቅም። በእርስዋ ምክንያት እንዳልሞት ብዬ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም አለ። ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው? ከሕዝብ አንዱ ከሚስትህ ጋር ሊተኛ ጥቂት በቀረው ነበር፥ ኃጢአትንም ልታመጣብን ነበር።

verses.en: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ። ይህን ሰው ሚስቱንም የሚነካ ሞትን ይሙት ብሎ አዘዘ።

verses.en: Then Yitschaq sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and YAHUAH blessed him.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም በዚያች ምድር ዘርን ዘራ፥ በዚያች ዓመትም መቶ እጥፍ አገኘ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ባረከው።

verses.en: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
verses.am: ባለ ጠጋ ሰውም ሆነ፥ እጅግ እስኪበልጥ ድረስም እየጨመረ ይበዛ ነበር፤

verses.en: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
verses.am: የበግና የላም ከብትም ሎሌዎችም እጅግ በዙለት፤ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ቀኑበት።

verses.en: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
verses.am: በአባቱ በአብርሃም ዘመን የአባቱ ሎሌዎች የማሱአቸውን ጕድጓዶች ሁሉ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ደፈኑአቸው አፈርንም ሞሉባቸው።

verses.en: And Abimelech said unto Yitschaq, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም ይስሐቅን። ከእኛ ተለይተህ ሂድ፥ ከእኛ ይልቅ እጅግ በርትተሃልና አለው።

verses.en: And Yitschaq departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ከዚያ ሄደ፥ በጌራራም ሸለቆ ሰፍሮ በዚያ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Yitschaq digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም በአባቱ በአብርሃም ዘመን ቈፍረዋቸው የነበሩትን የውኃ ጕድጓዶች ደግሞ አስቈፈረ፤ አብርሃም ከሞተ በኋላ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ደፍነዋቸው ነበሩና፤ አባቱም ይጠራቸው በነበረው ስም ጠራቸው።

verses.en: And Yitschaq's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
verses.am: የይስሐቅ ሎሌዎችም በሸለቆው ውስጥ ቈፈሩ፥ በዚያም የሚመነጭ የውኃ ጕድጓድ አገኙ።

verses.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Yitschaq's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
verses.am: የጌራራ አገር እረኞች ከይስሐቅ እረኞች ጋር። ውኃው የእኛ ነው ሲሉ ተከራከሩ፤ የዚያችንም ጕድጓድ ስም ኤሴቅ ብሎ ጠራት፥ ለእርስዋ ሲሉ ተጣልተዋልና።

verses.en: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
verses.am: ሌላ ጕድጓድም ማሱ፥ ስለ እርስዋም ደግሞ ተጣሉ፤ ስምዋንም ስጥና ብሎ ጠራት ።

verses.en: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now YAHUAH hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
verses.am: ከዚያም እልፍ ብሎ ሌላ ጕድጓድ አስቈፈረ፥ ስለ እርስዋም አልተጣሉም፤ ስምዋንም ርኆቦት ብሎ ጠራት እንዲህ ሲል። አሁን እግዚአብሔር አሰፋልን፥ በምድርም እንበዛለን።

verses.en: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
verses.am: በዚያም መሠዊያን ሠራ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራ፥ በዚያም ድንኳን ተከለ፤ የይስሐቅም ሎሌዎች በዚያ ጕድጓድ ማሱ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am YAHUAH of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
verses.am: በዚያም መሠዊያን ሠራ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራ፥ በዚያም ድንኳን ተከለ፤ የይስሐቅም ሎሌዎች በዚያ ጕድጓድ ማሱ።

verses.en: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of YAHUAH, and pitched his tent there: and there Yitschaq's servants digged a well.
verses.am: አቢሜሌክና የሙሽራው ወዳጅ አኮዘት የሠራዊቱም አለቃ ፊኮል ከጌራራ ወደ እርሱ ሄዱ።

verses.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
verses.am: ይስሐቅም። ለምን ወደ እኔ መጣችሁ? እናንተ ጠልታችሁኛል፥ ከእናንተም ለይታችሁ አሳድዳችሁኛል አላቸው።

verses.en: And Yitschaq said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.en: And they said, We saw certainly that YAHUAH was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
verses.am: ይስሐቅም ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.en: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ማልደውም ተነሡ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ተማማሉ፤ ይስሐቅም አሰናበታቸው፥ ከእርሱም ወጥተው በደኅና ሄዱ።

verses.en: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የይስሐቅ ሎሌዎች መጡ፥ ስለቈፈሩአትም ጕድጓድ። ውኃ አገኘን ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Yitschaq sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.am: ስምዋንም ሳቤህ ብሎ ጠራት፤ ስለዚህም የከተማይቱ ስም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ቤርሳቤህ ነው።

verses.en: And it came to pass the same day, that Yitschaq's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
verses.am: ዔሳውም አርባ ዓመት ሲሆነው የኬጢያዊ የብኤሪን ልጅ ዮዲትን፥ የኬጢያዊ የኤሎንን ልጅ ቤሴሞትንም ሚስቶች አድርጎ አገባ፤

verses.en: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.
verses.am: እነርሱም የይስሐቅንና የርብቃን ልብ ያሳዝኑ ነበር። a

verses.en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Yahudith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
Which were a grief of mind unto Yitschaq and to Rebekah.
And it came to pass, that when Yitschaq was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
verses.am: ይስሐቅ ሸምግሎ ዓይኖቹ ከማየት በፈዘዙ ጊዜ ታላቁን ልጁን ዔሳውን ጠርቶ። ልጄ ሆይ አለው፤ እርሱም። እነሆ አለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
verses.am: እርሱም አለው። እነሆ እኔ አረጀሁ፥ የምሞትበትን ቀን አላውቅም።

verses.en: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
verses.am: አሁንም ማደኛህን የፍላጻህን አፎትና ቀስትህን ውሰድ፥ ወደ ምድረ በዳም ውጣ፥ አደንም አድንልኝ፤

verses.en: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
verses.am: ሳልሞትም ነፍሴ እንድትባርክህ የጣፈጠ መብል እኔ እንደምወደው አዘጋጅተህ እበላ ዘንድ አምጣልኝ።

verses.en: And Rebekah heard when Yitschaq spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
verses.am: ርብቃም ይስሐቅ ለልጁ ለዔሳው ሲነግር ትሰማ ነበር። ዔሳውም አደን አድኖ ሊያመጣ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄደ።

verses.en: And Rebekah spake unto Ya'aqob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
verses.am: ርብቃም ልጅዋን ያዕቆብን እንዲህ አለችው። እነሆ፥ አባትህ ለወንድምህ ለዔሳው።

verses.en: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before YAHUAH before my death.
verses.am: አደን አድነህ አምጣልኝ፥ ሳልሞትም በልቼ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንድባርክህ የጣፈጠ መብል አድርግልኝ ብሎ ሲነግረው ሰማሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ እኔ በማዝዝህ ነገር ስማኝ፤

verses.en: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
verses.am: ወደ መንጋ ሄደህ ሁለት መልካካም ጠቦቶች አምጣልኝ፤ እነርሱንም ጣፋጭ መብል ለአባትህ እንደሚወደው አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
verses.am: ለአባትህም፥ ሳይሞት እንዲባርክህ፥ ይበላ ዘንድ ታገባለታለህ።

verses.en: And Ya'aqob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ርብቃን እናቱን አላት። እነሆ ዔሳው ወንድሜ ጠጕራም ሰው ነው፥ እኔ ግን ለስላሳ ነኝ፤

verses.en: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
verses.am: ምናልባት አባቴ ቢዳስሰኝ በፊቱ እንደሚዘብት እሆናለሁ፤ መርገምንም በላዬ አመጣለሁ፥ በረከትን አይደለም።

verses.en: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
verses.am: እናቱም አለችው። ልጄ ሆይ፥ መርገምህ በእኔ ላይ ይሁን፤ ቃሌን ብቻ ስማኝ፤ ሂድና አምጣልኝ።

verses.en: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
verses.am: ሄዶም አመጣ፥ ለእናቱም ሰጣት፤ እናቱም የጣፈጠውን መብል አባቱ እንደሚወደው አደረገች።
